declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit?

declarations.text:
Your body is a temple. Not a metaphor. A fact.
The Holy Spirit lives in you.
Honor God with how you treat what He lives in.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you?

declarations.text:
Fear of disease is a thief. Refuse it.
God promised protection from the plague that destroys at midday.
Dwelling in God's presence is the best health coverage on earth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will not fear the terror of night... nor the plague that destroys at midday.

declarations.text:
He was pierced. He was crushed. He was punished.
So that you could be healed.
By His wounds, it is already settled. Do not negotiate with what is done.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he was pierced for our transgressions... and by his wounds we are healed.

declarations.text:
God is your strength. Your shield. He helps you.
Trust Him with your body the way you trust Him with your soul.
Your health is not outside of His care.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

declarations.text:
A tranquil heart gives LIFE to the body.
Anxiety and peace do not produce the same results.
What you carry in your heart shows up in your body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A tranquil heart gives life to the body.

declarations.text:
Jesus gave authority to cure diseases. That authority still stands.
You pray to a God who heals. Not who healed.
His power to cure is active. Not past tense.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases.

declarations.text:
What you focus on fills your whole body.
If your eyes are healthy, your body is full of light.
Fix your eyes on the Healer, not the sickness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are healthy, your whole body will be full of light.

declarations.text:
You are a new creation. The old is gone.
Sickness does not have the same authority over the new creation.
Speak to your body from that new identity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come.

declarations.text:
Whatever you ask in prayer, believe you have ALREADY received it.
Not after you feel it. Not after you see it.
Belief goes before the evidence. That is how it works.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

declarations.text:
By His wounds, you are healed. That is past tense.
Not waiting to be healed. Already healed.
Stand on what was already accomplished.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By his wounds we are healed.

declarations.text:
Jesus bore your pain so you do not have to beg for healing.
You are not fighting FOR it. You are standing IN it.
Calvary settled the healing question. Walk in the answer.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely he took up our pain and bore our suffering.

declarations.text:
The Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives IN YOU.
Not near you. Not around you. IN you.
That resurrection power is already at work in your body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies.

declarations.text:
God sent out His word and healed them.
Speak that word over your body.
Your voice carries authority when it lines up with His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He sent out his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

declarations.text:
God declared it over you: I will restore your health.
He will heal every wound. Every one.
This is not your hope. This is His declaration.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds, declares the Lord.

declarations.text: Faith does not need your eyes. Stop waiting for proof before you move.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we live by faith, not by sight.

declarations.text: You do not need MORE faith. You need to USE the faith you already have.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move.

declarations.text: Nothing is impossible for you. The only question is: do you believe it?
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everything is possible for one who believes.

declarations.text: God made a promise. He has the power to keep it. Settle that in your mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Being fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

declarations.text: Christ gave His life for yours. Live like that trade was worth it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God.

declarations.text: Faith is not just a feeling. It is your shield. Pick it up and use it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

declarations.text: Faith does not come from striving. It comes from hearing God's Word. Stop. Listen.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

declarations.text: You were born to overcome. Your faith is the proof. Use it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

declarations.text: You cannot please God with effort alone. Trust is the currency of faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And without faith it is impossible to please God.

declarations.text: Ask and believe. Doubt kills what faith starts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt.

declarations.text: Peace with God is not earned. It is received through faith. Stop working for what is already yours.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God.

declarations.text: You belong to God. Not by birth. Not by behavior. By faith in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith.

declarations.text: Pray like it is already done. Because in the spirit realm, it is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

declarations.text: The storm is real. So is God. Stand firm. Do not flinch.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

declarations.text: Your salvation cost you nothing. It cost God everything. Receive it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.

declarations.text: He promised. He is faithful. Hold on to that and do not let go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

declarations.text: That trial is not breaking you. It is building you. Do not quit now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

declarations.text: Your faith can bring healing. Speak it out loud. Do not stay silent.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He said to her, 'Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace.'

declarations.text: Stop looking at the problem. Fix your eyes on Jesus. He finishes what He starts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith.

declarations.text: The righteous live by faith. Not by sight. Not by feeling. By faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The righteous will live by their faith.

declarations.text: Your faith moves God. Not your talent. Not your track record. Your faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, 'Son, your sins are forgiven.'

declarations.text: Faith is not hoping something might happen. It is knowing it already is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.

declarations.text: Every promise of God is yes. Your circumstances do not change that.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are 'Yes' in Christ.

declarations.text: He raised Jesus from the dead. Your situation is not too far gone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He was fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

declarations.text: Even when your faith is weak, God stays faithful. He cannot deny Himself.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot disown himself.

declarations.text: Stop describing the dead thing. Start calling it alive. Speak what God sees.
declarations.bibleVerseText: ...the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being things that were not.

declarations.text: Faith without action is dead. Move. Do the next right thing. Trust while you walk.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.

declarations.text: What looks impossible to you is an invitation to God. Bring it to Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

declarations.text: God is your refuge. Not after the storm. Right in the middle of it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

declarations.text: Stop trying to earn God's approval. You already have it. Through Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ.

declarations.text: God's power works best in weakness. Stop hiding yours. Let Him in.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: Grace is not a reward. It is a river. You cannot earn it. Just receive it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

declarations.text: Go to God boldly. He is not annoyed by your need. He is ready to help.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us then approach God's throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

declarations.text: Your best days are not from you. They are from God working through you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect.

declarations.text: Every sin you carry has already been paid for. You are free to start again.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: Where sin goes deeper, grace goes further. You cannot out-sin God's grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But where sin increased, grace increased all the more.

declarations.text: You did not earn your salvation. Stop trying to maintain it by works.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.

declarations.text: Sin has no power over you. Grace rules your life now. Walk in that freedom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

declarations.text: Your calling was set before you took your first breath. You are not an accident.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But when God, who set me apart from my mother's womb and called me by his grace, was pleased to reveal his Son in me.

declarations.text: God does not give you just enough. He gives you more than enough. Believe that.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

declarations.text: You were not made to carry this alone. His yoke is easy. Let Him carry it with you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.

declarations.text: Strength does not come from trying harder. It comes from God's Spirit. Stop straining.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord Almighty.

declarations.text: God called you to His glory. He will restore what you lost. Hold on.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you.

declarations.text: Be strong. Not by willpower. By the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: You are accepted in Christ. Not because of what you do. Because of who He is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To the praise of the glory of His grace, by which He made us accepted in the Beloved.

declarations.text: Your life is not your own story. It is God's testimony. Live it that way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I consider my life worth nothing to me... the task of testifying to the good news of God's grace.

declarations.text: God's favor surrounds you like a shield. Stop walking like you are on your own.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you, Lord, bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: Your past is gone. As far as east is from west. Stop going back to pick it up.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

declarations.text: You are not changed by effort. You are changed by looking at Him. Keep looking.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We all... are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory.

declarations.text: Goodness and love are chasing you today. Not punishment. Not failure. His love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life.

declarations.text: Grace did not just open the door for you. It pulled out a chair. Sit down.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he chose us in him before the creation of the world.

declarations.text: Your weakness is not a problem to fix. It is exactly where God's power goes to work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: Grace is not a pass for comfort. It is fuel for transformation. Use it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people. It teaches us to say 'No' to ungodliness.

declarations.text: Grace does not run out. Every gap in your life has been covered. Every single one.
declarations.bibleVerseText: From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.

declarations.text: God works in all things. Even the worst ones. Especially the worst ones.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.

declarations.text: Every debt is paid. Every sin is forgiven. Walk in that freedom today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace.

declarations.text: Grace made you an heir. Not a beggar. Not a visitor. An heir. Act like it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.

declarations.text: Your standing before God is not built on effort. It is built on grace. That does not crack.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing.

declarations.text: Grace and works cannot mix. You are under grace. Stand on it. Stop striving.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And if by grace, then it cannot be based on works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.

declarations.text: Do not waste God's grace. Let it do its work. Let it change everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As God's co-workers we urge you not to receive God's grace in vain.

declarations.text: God's love for you is not a feeling that fades. It is an everlasting covenant.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.

declarations.text: Love comes from God. When you love people well, God flows through you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God.

declarations.text: Love does not keep a record. Stop adding up what others owe you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs.

declarations.text: Knowing God's love is not just a nice feeling. It is the source of your power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And I pray that you, being rooted and established in love, may have power... to grasp how wide and long and high and deep is the love of Christ.

declarations.text: Fear and God's love cannot live in the same room. Let His love in. Fear has to go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear.

declarations.text: God's love for you is not small. It is bigger than your biggest mistake.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him.

declarations.text: God did not just love you. He lavished it on you. That means He poured it all out.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God!

declarations.text: The greatest love is not words. It is sacrifice. Open your hands. Give.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends.

declarations.text: Half-hearted love is not love. Give God everything. He gave you everything first.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.

declarations.text: You are called to make peace. Not to win arguments. Let love lead your words.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

declarations.text: Nothing you have done. Nothing done to you. Nothing above or below. Nothing separates you from His love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God.

declarations.text: Love your enemies. Pray for those who hurt you. That is God's love in action through you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.

declarations.text: Over everything else, put on love. It holds everything else together.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.

declarations.text: You can call yourself a Christian all you want. Your love is the proof.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.

declarations.text: Christ forgave you fully. Forgive others the same way. No conditions.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.

declarations.text: Love is not a speech. It is a lifestyle. Show it. Do not just say it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dear children, let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth.

declarations.text: God's love is not earned by good feelings. It is poured in by His Spirit. Every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God's love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: Your words carry weight. Let them carry grace. Build people up. Do not tear them down.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt.

declarations.text: Christ loved first and gave everything. That is the standard. Walk in it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Follow God's example, therefore, as dearly loved children and walk in the way of love, just as Christ loved us.

declarations.text: Do not let evil win. Overcome it with good. Love is a weapon and it always wins.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

declarations.text: God rejoices over you with singing. Stop searching for worth in people's approval.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord your God is with you... He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.

declarations.text: You can have every gift and still be nothing. Without love, nothing counts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

declarations.text: You did not clean yourself up before God loved you. He loved you in your worst moment.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

declarations.text: His love is not a feeling. It is a covenant. It will not break. It will not leave.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.

declarations.text: Stop performing for God's love. It was already lavished on you. Receive it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God!

declarations.text: Your best days do not earn more love. Your worst days do not lose it. Nothing changes His love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Neither death nor life... will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

declarations.text: You can only love like this because He loved you first. Go love people from that place.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We love because he first loved us.

declarations.text: Love is patient. Love is kind. That is not a personality type. It is a choice you make daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

declarations.text: Love protects. Love trusts. Love hopes. Love stays. Be that kind of person.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

declarations.text: Love your neighbor like yourself. Start with the people closest to you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The second is this: Love your neighbor as yourself. There is no commandment greater than these.

declarations.text: Give thanks in everything. Not for everything. God is still in control of all of it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: His compassions are new every morning. You wake up to a fresh supply of grace. Be thankful.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed... his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

declarations.text: Do not forget what God has done. Your memory of His goodness is fuel for today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

declarations.text: Do not forget what God has done for you. His goodness deserves your loudest voice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

declarations.text: Complaining is a habit. So is gratitude. Choose which one you train. Choose wisely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

declarations.text: Every good gift comes from above. Look around. You are surrounded by His goodness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights.

declarations.text: Thank God before the blessing arrives. His love never fails. That is always worth thanking Him for.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water.

declarations.text: Walk through His gates with thanks. Every person in your life is a gift. Treat them that way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise.

declarations.text: Anxiety breaks when gratitude enters. Bring your worries to God with thanksgiving. Every time.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation... with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

declarations.text: Who in your life has shown up for you? Thank God for them today. Out loud.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I thank my God every time I remember you.

declarations.text: A thankful heart is a growing heart. Overflow in gratitude and watch your roots go deeper.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

declarations.text: Stop counting what is missing. Count what is here. Godliness with contentment is great gain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

declarations.text: God already gave you the victory through Christ. Thank Him before you see it. That is faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: Let God's peace rule in you. Let gratitude be the proof that it does.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts... And be thankful.

declarations.text: Make His deeds known. You are not keeping your testimony to yourself. Share it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks to the Lord, call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

declarations.text: A cheerful heart turns every ordinary day into a feast. Choose it on purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.

declarations.text: God's Word is a lamp for your feet. Every step you take in the dark, it lights the next one.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

declarations.text: God is your shield and your strength. He covers what you cannot. Trust that today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

declarations.text: God is good. His love never ends. That is enough reason to praise Him right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

declarations.text: Contentment is learned. Not given. Start learning it. God is with you in every season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have learned to be content whatever the circumstances.

declarations.text: God gave you the power to create. Start every day by thanking Him for it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.

declarations.text: The heavens shout the glory of God. Look up. Look around. And say thank you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

declarations.text: You received a kingdom that cannot shake. Respond with gratitude. Every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful.

declarations.text: Praising God is not optional for those who know who He is. Make it your daily rhythm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High.

declarations.text: God keeps you safe while you sleep. Your life is a testimony. Wake up and declare it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

declarations.text: Thanksgiving before the answer is not being naive. It is faith in action. Do it now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

declarations.text: Giving thanks in all circumstances is not a suggestion. It is a weapon. Use it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: You are alive. Forgiven. Held. That is more than enough reason to praise God right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

declarations.text: You are not consumed. God's compassions did not run out today. That is mercy. Thank Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.

declarations.text: Your situation may not be perfect. God is. Walk into His presence with that truth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

declarations.text: You were made to praise. Not just on Sunday. Every day. Every breath.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will praise the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

declarations.text: Thanksgiving is the door to God's presence. Enter it with everything you have.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise.

declarations.text: Put His praise on your lips and keep it there. At all times. Not just the good ones.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

declarations.text: God is good. His love never ends. That is not a slogan. It is a reason to shout.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

declarations.text: A sacrifice of praise costs you something. Offer it when it is hard. That is when it counts most.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise.

declarations.text: Shout to God with joy. Your praise does not just fill the room. It shifts it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

declarations.text: Every good thing in your life came from above. Honor the Giver. Not just the gift.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights.

declarations.text: Give thanks with everything in you. Tell the story of what He has done. Do not stay quiet.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

declarations.text: Sing to the Lord. He is highly exalted. Your voice was made for this.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will sing to the Lord, for he is highly exalted.

declarations.text: Let your life shine before others. When they see it, they give glory to your Father. That is praise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

declarations.text: God inhabits your praise. When you worship, you are not alone. He moves in.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

declarations.text: Praise God for what He has done. For what He is doing. For what He will do.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.

declarations.text: Declare His love in the morning. Declare His faithfulness at night. Every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High, proclaiming your love in the morning.

declarations.text: Remember what God has done before. That memory builds hope for what He will do next.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will remember the deeds of the Lord; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

declarations.text: Victory is yours. Not one day. Now. Dance like Miriam danced. God already won.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Miriam the prophet... led all the women out and they danced.

declarations.text: You prayed. He answered. He delivered you from every fear. Praise Him for that today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I sought the Lord, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

declarations.text: Do everything without grumbling. Yes, everything. Your praise silences your complaint.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.

declarations.text: Give thanks in every circumstance. Not because of the circumstance. Because of who God is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: Praise His holy name with everything in you. Not part of you. All of you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

declarations.text: You walk in His presence and His light. That is something worth declaring every single day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, Lord.

declarations.text: Proclaim His love in the morning. His faithfulness at night. This is who you were made to be.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To proclaim your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night.

declarations.text: Shout for joy. Burst into song. God's faithfulness is a reason for your loudest praise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music.

declarations.text: Do not forget His benefits. Not one of them. Count them. Name them. Thank Him for them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits.

declarations.text: Trust God's Word. Praise it. When you know His Word is true, fear has no ground.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In God, whose word I praise—in God I trust and am not afraid.

declarations.text: If you have breath, you have a reason to praise. Do not waste a single one.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord.

declarations.text: Praise is a sacrifice when things are hard. Offer it anyway. God is worthy even in the hard.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise.

declarations.text: God is enthroned on your praise. When you worship, the King takes His seat. Let Him in.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yet you are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.

declarations.text: Put God's praise on your lips and leave it there. In the good times and the hard ones.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

declarations.text: Praise is not performance. It is warfare. When the praise went up, the ambush came down.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As they began to sing and praise, the Lord set ambushes against the men of Ammon and Moab.

declarations.text: Shout for joy to God. Not to get something from Him. Just because of who He is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth. Worship the Lord with gladness.

declarations.text: Put on every piece of God's armor. The enemy has a plan for you. Don't walk into the fight half-dressed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil's schemes.

declarations.text: Every weapon aimed at your life was already defeated before it fired. God settled that.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you.

declarations.text: God gave you authority to crush the enemy. Stop asking for permission you already have.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy.

declarations.text: You are not fighting to win. You are more than a conqueror. That battle is already decided.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

declarations.text: The Lord is a warrior. Not was. IS. He fights your battles while you stand firm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is a warrior; the Lord is his name.

declarations.text: The Word of God is your weapon. Every lie the enemy tells has an answer. Use it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

declarations.text: Ten thousand can surround you. God surrounds them. Fear has no math that beats that.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not fear though tens of thousands assail me on every side.

declarations.text: Your weapons are divine. They level strongholds. The battle in your mind can be won.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world... they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

declarations.text: Submit to God first. Then resist the devil. He will not stay. He MUST flee.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

declarations.text: Your strength does not come from you. It comes from the Lord. That changes everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

declarations.text: God commanded His angels about you. You have backup you cannot see. Walk with confidence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: Say the mountain into the sea. Faith is not silent. It speaks and expects results.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, 'Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and does not doubt in their heart... it will be done.

declarations.text: In your hardest day, God hides you in His own shelter. The enemy cannot reach you there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent.

declarations.text: What you bind on earth is bound in heaven. You have more authority than you use. Use it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven.

declarations.text: The One inside you is greater than the one in the world. You already have the bigger side.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

declarations.text: Jesus did not say you would avoid trouble. He said He already overcame it. Take heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

declarations.text: A soldier does not get tangled in civilian life. Stay focused on your commanding officer.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one serving as a soldier gets involved in civilian affairs; rather, they try to please their commanding officer.

declarations.text: Put on the helmet of salvation. Your mind is a battlefield. Guard it daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And take the helmet of salvation.

declarations.text: Every arrow the enemy fires has a name on it. Your shield of faith stops all of them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

declarations.text: God always leads you in victory. Not sometimes. ALWAYS. That is His promise. Walk in it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God, who always leads us as captives in Christ's triumphal procession.

declarations.text: God did not give you a spirit of fear. He gave you power, love, and a sound mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

declarations.text: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower. Run to it. Safety is already inside.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

declarations.text: The light shines in the darkness. The darkness did not win then. It will not win now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

declarations.text: The wicked run when no one chases them. The righteous stand bold as a lion. Know which one you are.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The wicked flee though no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

declarations.text: God gives you the victory through Christ. Not might. Not strategy. Through HIM.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: Passive faith is not faith. Put on the full armor. God expects you to advance, not wait.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil's schemes.

declarations.text: At the name of Jesus, every knee bows. Heaven, earth, and under the earth. Every knee. Use that name.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth.

declarations.text: The victory was won before you entered the fight. You are not fighting FOR it. You are fighting FROM it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: Your weapons are not human. They are divine. They demolish strongholds. No lie in your mind survives them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

declarations.text: You overcome by the blood of the Lamb and the word of your testimony. Speak it out. It matters.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony.

declarations.text: The safest place in the universe is under the shadow of God. That is where you live.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: No weapon formed against you will succeed. Not some. Not most. NONE. God guarantees it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No weapon forged against you will prevail.

declarations.text: God commanded His angels about you. They are on assignment right now. You are guarded.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: You can lie down in peace and sleep. God is awake so you do not have to be.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

declarations.text: Bad news loses its power when your heart is fixed on God. Trust Him. Stand steady.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord.

declarations.text: When fear hits, run to the Lord. He is a fortified tower. You are safe the moment you enter.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

declarations.text: Keep your eyes on the Lord. With Him at your right side, nothing can shake you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I keep my eyes always on the Lord. With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

declarations.text: The Lord watches over your life. Not part of it. All of it. Every moment covered.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will keep you from all harm—he will watch over your life.

declarations.text: God is a wall of fire around you. His glory is within. Darkness does not get past that.
declarations.bibleVerseText: 'And I myself will be a wall of fire around it,' declares the Lord, 'and I will be its glory within.'

declarations.text: The darkest valley does not stop you when God is with you. Walk through it. Fear no evil.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.

declarations.text: God saves you from the traps set against you. You do not have to see them to be free of them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely he will save you from the fowler's snare and from the deadly pestilence.

declarations.text: In your darkest day, God hides you in His dwelling. The enemy cannot reach you there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling.

declarations.text: God watches over your coming and going. Both directions. Both now and forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

declarations.text: The Lord is your light and your salvation. Who is left to fear? Name them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear?

declarations.text: God surrounds you with favor like a shield. You do not walk into a room unprotected.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you, Lord, bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: No harm will overtake you. No disaster will reach your home. God covers what He calls His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.

declarations.text: The Lord is faithful. He strengthens you. He protects you from the evil one. That is a promise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

declarations.text: You do not have to fear what comes at night or at noon. God covers every hour of your day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day.

declarations.text: God is your hiding place. He surrounds you with songs of deliverance. Run to Him first.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.

declarations.text: God's peace surpasses understanding. It guards your heart and mind in Christ. You cannot explain it. Just receive it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the peace of God... will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: Those who trust in the Lord cannot be shaken. They stand like Mount Zion. That is your ground.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

declarations.text: The Lord is your rock and fortress. Build on Him. What is built on solid rock does not fall.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge.

declarations.text: Listen to God's wisdom and live in safety. Ignore it and fear becomes your constant companion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm.

declarations.text: No one will snatch you out of His hand. Not the enemy. Not your past. Not your failures.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one will snatch them out of my hand.

declarations.text: The Lord is your helper. You do not have to be afraid. Say it with confidence, not just hope.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So we say with confidence, 'The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid.'

declarations.text: A thousand may fall at your side. Ten thousand at your right. But it will not come near you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.

declarations.text: Weapons form. They always will. But none of them will succeed. God made that promise. Stand on it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No weapon forged against you will prevail.

declarations.text: God commanded angels about you. They guard your steps and your purpose. You are not alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: The safest place you can be is hidden under the shadow of the Most High. Stay there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: Nothing reaches you without passing through your Father's hands first. That is real protection.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.

declarations.text: Ask God for a clean heart. Ask for a renewed spirit. He does not turn that prayer away.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

declarations.text: Pure in heart. That is who sees God. Not the loudest person in the room. The cleanest.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

declarations.text: How does a young person stay pure? By living in God's Word. No other shortcut works.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word.

declarations.text: Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit. That is not a suggestion. That changes how you live.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit... Therefore honor God with your bodies.

declarations.text: What you think about shapes who you become. Think on what is true, pure, and excellent.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Finally, brothers and sisters, whatever is true... whatever is pure... think about such things.

declarations.text: The old is gone. The new has come. Stop going back to what Christ already buried.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

declarations.text: Guard your heart like your life depends on it. Because everything you do flows from it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

declarations.text: Cleanse yourself from the wrong things. Become a vessel for honor. God has work that needs you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who cleanse themselves from the latter will be instruments for special purposes... prepared to do any good work.

declarations.text: Walk in the light like He is in the light. No hiding. No shadows. Full fellowship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another.

declarations.text: Nothing worthless gets a foothold in your eyes. Guard what you let in. What you see shapes you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile.

declarations.text: You were washed. You were made right. You were set apart. That happened. Walk like it did.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: Run from evil desires. Do not negotiate with them. Run. Then chase righteousness, faith, and love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace.

declarations.text: Clean hands and a pure heart. That is who receives blessing from the Lord. Be that person.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart... will receive blessing from the Lord.

declarations.text: Stop fitting in with this world. Be transformed. Renew your mind. Know what God actually wants.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

declarations.text: Do not let one rotten word leave your mouth. Only speak what builds. Every word is a choice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up.

declarations.text: You have hope in Christ. That hope purifies you. Act like someone who belongs to Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All who have this hope in him purify themselves, just as he is pure.

declarations.text: Everyone born of God overcomes the world. Your faith is the victory. Use it like it is real.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

declarations.text: Give your body to God as a living sacrifice. Holy and pleasing. That is your act of worship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, I urge you... to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God.

declarations.text: God clothed you in salvation. He wrapped you in righteousness. Live like someone dressed by God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I delight greatly in the Lord... for he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of his righteousness.

declarations.text: Confess it. He forgives it. He wipes it clean. Do not carry what God already removed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness.

declarations.text: Be blameless and pure in a crooked generation. Shine like a light in the dark. The contrast is the point.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So that you may become blameless and pure, 'children of God without fault in a warped and crooked generation.'

declarations.text: God's grace teaches you to say no to sin and yes to godly living. Grace is not a pass. It is a trainer.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the grace of God has appeared... It teaches us to say 'No' to ungodliness and worldly passions.

declarations.text: A pure heart and gracious words bring favor with the most powerful people in the room.
declarations.bibleVerseText: One who loves a pure heart and who speaks with grace will have the king for a friend.

declarations.text: Integrity is your safety. Walk in it and you walk securely. Hide from it and you will be found out.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.

declarations.text: A calm heart gives life to your body. What you carry inside shows up outside. Guard it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A tranquil heart gives life to the body.

declarations.text: Guard your heart above everything else. What flows from it shapes every part of your life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

declarations.text: You were washed. You were set apart. You were made right. Walk in that. Do not go back.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. Treat it like God lives there. Because He does.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you?

declarations.text: This hope in Christ is working on you. It is making you clean. Let it do its work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone who has this hope in him purifies himself, just as he is pure.

declarations.text: Run from evil. Chase righteousness, faith, love, and peace. That chase is worth your whole life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Flee the evil desires of youth and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace.

declarations.text: Love is not just a feeling. If you love God, you keep His commands. That is how love works.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you love me, keep my commands.

declarations.text: Knowing is not enough. Doing is the blessing. You already know enough. Do it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.

declarations.text: Do not delay. Hasten to obey God's commands. Every slow step has a cost. Move quickly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.

declarations.text: God's sheep know His voice. They follow Him. If you belong to Him, tune in. Then move.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

declarations.text: God will make you the head and not the tail. Above and not below. Obedience is the condition.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail... if you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God.

declarations.text: When God and people disagree, choose God. Every time. Without apology.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We must obey God rather than human beings!

declarations.text: Walk in God's commands and walk in freedom. Obedience is not a cage. It is the open field.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

declarations.text: Do not just listen to the Word and walk away unchanged. Do what it says. That is where life changes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

declarations.text: You are a friend of God when you do what He commands. That friendship has a condition. Meet it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are my friends if you do what I command.

declarations.text: There is great reward in keeping God's commands. Not just peace. Not just order. Great REWARD.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In keeping them there is great reward.

declarations.text: When you are unsure which way to go, a Voice will tell you. This is the way. Walk in it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, 'This is the way; walk in it.'

declarations.text: When you consider all of God's commands and keep them, shame has no place to stand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.

declarations.text: Hear God's words and put them into practice. That is wisdom. That is the house that holds.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

declarations.text: You can delight in doing God's will. His law in your heart makes obedience a joy, not a burden.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I desire to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart.

declarations.text: Be strong and courageous. Obey every command. Do not turn right or left. Straight ahead.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law... do not turn from it to the right or to the left.

declarations.text: To obey is better than to sacrifice. God does not want your offering. He wants your obedience.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To obey is better than sacrifice.

declarations.text: Walk in the light like God is in the light. That is where real connection happens.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another.

declarations.text: Let your light shine before people. When they see your good works, they will glorify God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

declarations.text: Whoever keeps God's commands is the one who loves Him. Love is not just words. It is action.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me.

declarations.text: Be willing and obedient. The good of the land is the reward. That is a promise worth chasing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good things of the land.

declarations.text: Be faithful in small things. God is watching. What you do with little decides what you get with much.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things.

declarations.text: Live with a clear conscience. Honor God in every area. That is not a performance. It is freedom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pray for us. We are sure that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

declarations.text: Listen to God's wisdom and live in safety. Turn away from it and fear becomes your home.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm.

declarations.text: People who know their God resist the enemy and take action. Knowledge leads to boldness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the people who know their God will firmly resist him and take action.

declarations.text: You are God's work. Created in Christ to do good works. He prepared them in advance. Walk in them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works.

declarations.text: You do not obey God to earn His love. You obey because you already have it. Obedience is the response.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you love me, keep my commands.

declarations.text: Put God's words into practice. Build your life like a wise man. When the storm hits, you will stand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

declarations.text: Willing and obedient. That is the condition. The good of the land is the result. Simple and true.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good things of the land.

declarations.text: You cannot please God and please everyone else at the same time. Choose who you are living for.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God?

declarations.text: Obedience is better than sacrifice. Listening is better than empty offerings. Go all the way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.

declarations.text: Two can defend themselves. But a cord of three strands does not break. Keep God in the middle.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Though one may be overpowered, two can defend themselves. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken.

declarations.text: Love is patient. Love is kind. Love is not proud. Choose it again today. It is a daily decision.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

declarations.text: God saw that being alone was not good. He made a helper fit for the purpose. Be that. Daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord God said, 'It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.'

declarations.text: Your tongue holds the power of life and death. Use it to build your spouse. Not tear them down.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

declarations.text: Be kind. Be compassionate. Forgive each other. God forgave you first. That sets the standard.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.

declarations.text: Let the peace of Christ be the ruler in your home. Not your mood. Not your feelings. His peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace.

declarations.text: Honor your marriage. Keep your vows pure. Faithfulness is not a feeling. It is a daily choice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure.

declarations.text: Finding a spouse is finding something good. It is favor from the Lord. Treat it like it is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the Lord.

declarations.text: Be quick to listen. Slow to speak. Slow to get angry. That order matters in every marriage.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry.

declarations.text: God joined you together. What He joins, no one separates. Not conflict. Not pressure. Not time.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.

declarations.text: God restores what is broken and heals what has been wounded. Invite Him into your marriage.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds, declares the Lord.

declarations.text: Submit to each other out of reverence for Christ. Marriage is not a competition. It is a team.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

declarations.text: A cheerful heart is good medicine. Bring laughter into your marriage. Joy is a gift, not a bonus.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

declarations.text: A wise person builds their home. A foolish one tears it down with their own hands. Choose wisely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The wise woman builds her house, but with her own hands the foolish one tears hers down.

declarations.text: Pray for your spouse. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful. Use that power for them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.

declarations.text: Forget what is behind. Reach for what is ahead. Your past season is not your final one.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead.

declarations.text: Be humble. Be gentle. Be patient. Bear with each other in love. That is what real marriage looks like.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be completely humble and gentle; be patient, bearing with one another in love.

declarations.text: Ask God to make your love increase and overflow for your spouse. That is a prayer He loves to answer.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other.

declarations.text: Put away lying. Speak truth to each other. Honesty is not a threat to your marriage. It is the protection.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.

declarations.text: Encourage each other. Build each other up. Your marriage needs both voices. Use yours well.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up.

declarations.text: Do not let the sun go down on your anger. Deal with it. Tonight. Anger left overnight becomes a root.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry.

declarations.text: The Lord is faithful. He will strengthen your marriage and guard it from the enemy. Trust His faithfulness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

declarations.text: Love your spouse the way Christ loved the church. That is the standard. Not culture. Not comfort.
declarations.bibleVerseText: However, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

declarations.text: God has plans for your marriage. Plans for good and not for harm. Plans with a real future. Believe them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I know the plans I have for you... plans to give you hope and a future.

declarations.text: God began a good work in your marriage. He is not done with it. He will carry it to completion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

declarations.text: Unless the Lord builds your house, the work is wasted. Build it with God or it will not stand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain.

declarations.text: Love your spouse the way Christ loved the church. He gave everything. That is the model. Give fully.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her.

declarations.text: Honor your marriage. Keep it sacred. God honors the covenant. The enemy wants to break it. Do not help him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Marriage should be honored by all, and the marriage bed kept pure.

declarations.text: Pray for each other so that you may be healed. Prayer is one of the greatest gifts you give your spouse.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pray for each other so that you may be healed.

declarations.text: What God has joined, let no one separate. Not pressure. Not the past. Not the enemy. No one.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What God has joined together, let no one separate.

declarations.text: God doesn't hand you wealth. He gives you POWER to create it. Use what He put in your hands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.

declarations.text: Success is not luck. It is what happens when you obey God's Word. Meditate on it. Act on it. Win.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then you will be prosperous and successful.

declarations.text: God doesn't bless you just for you. He blesses you so you can overflow into others. Abundance has a PURPOSE.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times... you will abound in every good work.

declarations.text: God wants to open heaven over your life. But the door opens when you GIVE. Test Him and watch.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room enough to store it.

declarations.text: God's plan for you is not debt. It is overflow. You were built to lend, not borrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

declarations.text: Walking right with God and walking in wealth are not opposites. They go TOGETHER.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

declarations.text: God puts His blessing on your work. Not your best effort alone. Your work that is tied to HIM.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will send a blessing on your barns and on everything you put your hand to.

declarations.text: Your God is not broke. He meets your needs from the riches of His glory. Not your salary. HIS glory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: Shortcuts steal your future. Build slowly. Build right. And your wealth will LAST.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dishonest money dwindles away, but whoever gathers money little by little makes it grow.

declarations.text: God didn't bless you to stop at YOU. You are blessed to BE a blessing. Keep it moving.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will bless you... and you will be a blessing.

declarations.text: The Shepherd of your life says you lack NOTHING. Stop speaking lack over your own life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

declarations.text: God's supply is not natural. It is supernatural. He meets needs that make no sense on paper.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: You are not a servant. You are an HEIR. Stop living like you have no inheritance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So you are no longer a slave, but God's child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

declarations.text: Your hard work is not wasted. God rewards the fruit of your labor. Keep going.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.

declarations.text: The fire you walked through was not the end. It was the path INTO your place of abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

declarations.text: One stream is not enough. God calls you to invest in MANY. Diversify. Build. Protect.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Invest in seven ventures, yes, in eight; you do not know what disaster may come upon the land.

declarations.text: A good person builds wealth that outlives them. What are you building for the NEXT generation?
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children.

declarations.text: You don't have to grind yourself to nothing to build wealth. God's blessing makes you rich and adds NO sorrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: You can't out-give God. Pour into others and watch how quickly you get REFRESHED.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

declarations.text: God's will is that ALL things go well for you. Your finances. Your body. Your life. ALL of it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you.

declarations.text: The blessing of God follows you everywhere. In the city. In the country. There is no place you go without it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

declarations.text: Your best ideas are not just yours. Wisdom lives in God. Ask Him and He gives you the IDEAS.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.

declarations.text: God gives seed to SOWERS. Not watchers. Not wishers. Give the seed in your hand and watch it MULTIPLY.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now he who supplies seed to the sower... will also supply and increase your store of seed.

declarations.text: God enriches you so you can be generous. Abundance is not selfish. It is STRATEGIC for the kingdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will be enriched in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion.

declarations.text: God carries your burdens daily. Your job is to walk in gratitude while He works on your behalf.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.

declarations.text: God's blessing on your life is not a dead end. It flows THROUGH you. Be a channel, not a container.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you... and you will be a blessing.

declarations.text: Stop striving. Start abiding. God's blessing creates wealth without pain. The blessing does the heavy lifting.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: Honor God FIRST with your money. Not what is left over. The firstfruits unlock the floodgates.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops; then your barns will be filled to overflowing.

declarations.text: Talking about what you will do leads to poverty. DOING it brings profit. Stop talking. Start working.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.

declarations.text: The blessing doesn't stop at you. Build something that flows to your grandchildren. Generational wealth is God's idea.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good person leaves an inheritance for their children's children.

declarations.text: God wraps His favor around you like a shield. You don't earn it. You walk in it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you, Lord, bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: When God opens a door for you, no human can shut it. Stop asking people for permission.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

declarations.text: God gives you favor with people before you even open your mouth. His hand on you is VISIBLE.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.

declarations.text: God's face is turned toward you. His grace is ON you. That changes everything you touch today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.

declarations.text: You are not average. You are chosen. Royal. Set apart. Walk like you KNOW it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession.

declarations.text: God didn't stumble upon you. He CHOSE you. Deliberately. On purpose. That changes everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, Israel, my servant... whom I have chosen.

declarations.text: You didn't win because you were strong. God's favor did what your effort NEVER could. Rely on HIM.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It was not by their sword that they won the land... it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.

declarations.text: Favor grows. Jesus grew in favor with God AND people. You can too. It is a daily pursuit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

declarations.text: Highly favored is not a feeling. It is a FACT. The Lord is with you. Act like it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The angel went to her and said, 'Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.'

declarations.text: Every enemy that rises against you will be defeated. Not by you. By GOD. He fights for you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you.

declarations.text: God can change any leader's heart toward you. He did it for Daniel. He will do it for you.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now God had caused the official to show favor and compassion to Daniel.

declarations.text: Even in dry seasons, God leads you. Even in hard places, He satisfies your needs. Trust the guide.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land.

declarations.text: One day of FAVOR is better than a lifetime of LABOR. God gives you what you did not build.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build.

declarations.text: You didn't create your gifts. You RECEIVED them. Walk in humility and let God get the credit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For who makes you different from anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive?

declarations.text: God is a restorer. Every year the enemy stole, God will pay BACK. Your restoration is coming.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten.

declarations.text: You don't chase the blessing. The blessing chases YOU. God's goodness follows you all your days.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life.

declarations.text: Your promotion doesn't come from your boss. It comes from GOD. He is the one who lifts people up.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west... But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

declarations.text: Your greatest business advantage is having God WITH you. Joseph had it. You can too.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered.

declarations.text: Wherever God goes, favor follows. You carry His presence. That means favor goes WHERE YOU GO.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered.

declarations.text: Ask God to let His favor rest on your work. He establishes what His favor touches. Ask boldly.
